A wide establishing exterior shot of a traditional American cottage-style home photographed at standing eye level with a wide-to-normal lens, framing the full front facade and approach from across the front lawn. The camera is level, positioned at street-approach distance, capturing the home centered with the driveway leading toward it in a classic one-point perspective composition.

The house is a white-painted brick traditional cottage with steep gabled rooflines, charcoal asphalt shingles, and dark-framed multi-pane windows. Board-and-batten white siding panels flank the main brick facade sections. The front entry features a natural warm oak or pine wood door with a small covered stoop with timber-bracketed porch roof detail. Green shrub plantings and manicured boxwood borders line the foundation.

A smooth light grey concrete driveway curves gently from the foreground to the covered entry stoop, flanked on both sides by mown emerald-green lawn. On either side of the drive, tall matte-black rectangular post bollard fixtures stand at regular intervals along the path edge — two visible on each side — placed on small square concrete base pads on the grass. Between these posts, the lawn gives way to manicured plantings and foundation shrubs.

Mature leafy trees in full summer green canopy frame the background behind the house, against a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. The overall mood is crisp, bright, and aspirational — a daytime curb appeal shot with cool-to-neutral daylight rendering all surfaces crisply.
